# United States Last Will and Testament

> A planning and validity-checking form for a United States will. A single continuous single-page wizard collects the testator and state, the family and spouse, the estate and the specific and residuary bequests, the personal representative and standard clauses, the execution plan with witnesses, and the self-proving affidavit. The engine classifies the plan as **valid-ready-to-execute**, **incomplete**, or **formality-risk** and raises prioritized flagged issues.
